entries.description: Quota Check: Your quota against your on-target earnings, judged by what the number is measured in: new bookings, cloud consumption growth, or a whole book.
representativeQueries: is my quota crazy
quota to OTE ratio for cloud sales
is my sales quota fair

entries.description: Quota Case: Find the gap between last year and this year's quota: run rate or ARR, pipeline at your real win rate, headcount, one-time deals. Then push back with it, or close it with growth in existing accounts and net-new ones.
representativeQueries: how to push back on a quota that is too high
is my sales quota realistic compared to last year
find the gap between last year and this year's quota
my quota went up and my territory did not

entries.description: Territory Check: Can the territory make the number, or are you being asked to grow where nobody could? Five questions for sellers.
representativeQueries: can my territory make the number
is my sales territory viable
new territory sizing check

entries.description: Discount Check: How much discount is too much? See what it costs in your commission and the company's margin before you say yes.
representativeQueries: what does a discount cost me in commission
should I give a 15 percent discount
discount impact on margin and commission

entries.description: Pay Check: Base, variable, accelerator, cap and threshold in. What the plan pays at 50% to 200% of quota out, and where the upside goes.
representativeQueries: how much will my sales comp plan pay at 150% of quota
sales accelerator calculator
does my commission cap limit my upside
what does OTE really pay
comp plan payout curve

entries.description: Commission Check: Deal size, commission rate and your share of the credit in, what you actually take home out, after the share you set aside for taxes.
representativeQueries: how much of my commission do I take home
commission take home after taxes
commission check calculator

entries.description: Comp Plan Check: Five questions that find the red flags in a sales comp plan: crediting, payout timing, upside, clawbacks and mid-year changes.
representativeQueries: comp plan red flags
is my sales commission plan fair
questions to ask about a sales comp plan
commission clawback rules
who gets credit on a split deal

entries.description: Offer Check: Two sales job offers side by side: base, variable, ramp and guarantee in, year-one cash and a normal year at a realistic attainment out.
representativeQueries: compare two sales job offers
which sales offer pays more
OTE vs realistic earnings calculator
sales job offer ramp guarantee
year one sales compensation with ramp

entries.description: Pipeline Check: target, pipeline and win rate in, the gap out. 3X is a rule of thumb; your win rate says what you actually need.
representativeQueries: do I have enough pipeline to make my number
pipeline coverage calculator with my win rate
is 3X pipeline coverage enough

entries.description: Risk Check: Coverage says whether you have enough pipeline. This says how fragile it is: concentration, aging, next steps, timing and creation.
representativeQueries: how fragile is my pipeline
pipeline concentration and aging risk
4X coverage but still at risk

entries.description: Rep Check: Is it the rep, the territory, a skill gap or an effort gap? Five questions for sales managers that look at the territory before the person.
representativeQueries: is it the rep or the territory
why is my sales rep underperforming
rep problem or territory problem

entries.description: Partner Check: Five questions that separate a real partnership from promises: sourced deals, a named account, an owner who gets paid, a plan with dates, and pull.
representativeQueries: is this partner real or a logo
is my channel partner actually selling
partner check for co-sell

entries.description: Talent Review Check: Five questions that test the assessment you're making for a rep in a talent review (OLR, at Amazon), then the room pressure-tests you.
representativeQueries: prepare for OLR calibration
will my case for a rep survive talent review
Amazon OLR prep for managers

entries.description: Deal Check: five questions (customer, money, power, path, now) that separate proof from hopium in a federal deal.
representativeQueries: is my deal real or hopium
qualify a federal sales deal before commit
what will my manager ask about this deal

entries.description: Account Check: Five questions that tell you whether you know the account or only the opportunity in front of you: mission, money, power, incumbents, how they buy.
representativeQueries: do I know the account or just my contact
am I single-threaded in this account
federal account check

entries.description: Commit Check: For cloud and consumption sellers: will the customer use their committed spend? See the pace, the monthly spend it takes from here, and the shortfall or overage.
representativeQueries: will my customer burn their cloud commit
committed spend vs actual consumption
EDP commit burn down calculator
customer is behind on their committed spend
how much monthly spend to use a cloud commitment

entries.description: Competition Check: Five questions that tell you whether the incumbent, the competitor, or doing nothing is beating you right now.
representativeQueries: why would they pick us over doing nothing
am I beating the incumbent
competitive position check for a deal

entries.description: Brief Check: Five questions about the doc, deck or QBR you're about to present, then the room pressure-tests you.
representativeQueries: will my QBR survive the room
pressure test my brief before the meeting
